name: Border Sector Patrol - Long Corridor
mission_theme: Seven kilometre border strip with a valley dead zone: endurance, relay chain and long-range surveillance.

zones.notes: 7 km strip, 4 sectors, broken by the valley

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Perimeter patrol and intrusion response at PERIM-BORDER (sector S2)
tasks.brief: Patrol the closed perimeter PERIM-BORDER at 100 m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every 360 s. An intruder will enter from sector S2; detect it within 60 s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within 500 m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.
tasks.objective: Keep a continuous patrol of PERIM-BORDER at 100 m, detect an intrusion entering at sector S2 within 60 s, identify it positively and shadow it inside 500 m of the perimeter.

actions: assign one UAV per sector with overlap
hand the track to the nearest UAV

constraints: minimum altitude 100 m - 20 m
no pursuit outside 500 m
failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s
geofence breach during the pursuit
intruder never detected

checkpoints.name: Patrol continuity
checkpoints.metric: perimeter length covered per loop and loop period
checkpoints.target: >= 90% of the perimeter each loop, period <= 360 s

checkpoints.name: Detection latency
checkpoints.metric: time from intrusion to first detection report

checkpoints.name: Positive identification
checkpoints.metric: hover time within 60 m of the intruder
checkpoints.target: >= 5 s hover and ID record submitted

checkpoints.name: Shadowing
checkpoints.metric: intruder distance from the perimeter while shadowed
checkpoints.target: intruder never beyond 500 m unshadowed for > 20 s

checkpoints.name: Patrol resume
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the abandoned sector

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Relay chain between GS-CP-1 and GS-CP-2 (3 hops, 15 min)
tasks.brief: Link GS-CP-1 and GS-CP-2, which are 7600 m apart and cannot see each other. Fly a relay chain of 3 UAVs at 170 m AGL, keep the end-to-end link above -92 dBm for 15 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if a relay drops. No UAV may hover closer than 150 m to another.
tasks.objective: Position 3 UAVs so that GS-CP-1 and GS-CP-2 keep an end-to-end link with RSSI >= -92 dBm for 15 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if one relay is lost.

actions: compute relay positions on the GS-CP-1-GS-CP-2 line
assign one altitude per relay to reduce interference
fly to the slots at 170 m
replace a lost relay within 45 s
hand over or land at LZ-HQ

constraints: relay altitude >= 170 m - 20 m
no relay outside the geofence
failure_conditions: link down for more than 60 s in total
relay chain not established by t = 300 s
both relays hovering at the same slot

checkpoints.name: Chain setup
checkpoints.metric: time to first end-to-end link

checkpoints.name: Link continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of 15 min with RSSI >= -92 dBm

checkpoints.name: Re-form after loss
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the link after an injected relay loss

checkpoints.name: Packet delivery
checkpoints.metric: end-to-end packet loss

checkpoints.name: Relay separation
checkpoints.metric: distance between relay stations

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-SECTOR-A (85% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-SECTOR-A completely. Fly parallel tracks at 100 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 20 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 85 %. Recover to LZ-HQ when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-SECTOR-A with 2 UAVs at 100 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 85 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 20 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV leaves the geofence
any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
loss-of-control or collision flag

checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside BLOCK-SECTOR-A

checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-SECTOR-A at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.metric: landing separation and hard-landing flag
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-HQ, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.brief: Inspect POI-GATE-7. Hold a standoff of 20 m (tolerance 3 m) at 40 m AGL, aim the gimbal 30 deg down and take at least 4 images per face. constraints: hover only at declared capture points

failure_conditions: entering the 10 m keep-out radius

tasks.title: Search and rescue sweep of AREA-RIVER (sweep 100 m, beacon in C5)
tasks.brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in AREA-RIVER. Sweep the area cooperatively at 80 m with 100 m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within 25 m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.
tasks.objective: Sweep AREA-RIVER with 3 UAVs at 80 m using a 100 m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within 25 m and marked.

constraints: minimum separation 20 m

failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window

tasks.brief: Fly from WP-ENTRY-W to WP-EXIT-E through CORRIDOR-VALLEY in a column formation with 30 m spacing. Assemble the formation before the corridor entry; inside the corridor there are obstacle edges within 200 m. Keep formation error small, never trigger a separation warning, and complete the transit within 600 s. The corridor must be flown in complete radio silence: no transmissions between entry and exit.

build the column formation with 30 m spacing

constraints: constant speed inside the corridor

failure_conditions: corridor obstacle strike

tasks.title: Night thermal survey of BLOCK-SECTOR-B (85% target, no RGB)
tasks.brief: It is night and only the thermal payload works. Survey BLOCK-SECTOR-B at 110 m to 85 % coverage, and report every thermal hotspot above 120 degC with its position and peak temperature. The RGB camera must not be used, and no illumination is allowed. Re-visit any hotspot once to confirm it before reporting.
tasks.objective: Survey BLOCK-SECTOR-B at night with the thermal sensor only at 110 m, reaching 85 % coverage and flagging every hotspot above 120 degC.

actions: fly the tracks with the thermal payload

constraints: no illumination
thermal payload is the only sensor
altitude >= 60 m
failure_conditions: RGB used during the survey
no illumination allowed: any searchlight event
coverage below 75%

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-3 and UAV-4 at t=1200 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 1200 s, UAV-3 and UAV-4 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 50 % of the PERIM-BORDER work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of PERIM-BORDER running after UAV-3 and UAV-4 are lost at t = 1200 s, delivering at least 50 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-3 and UAV-4
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s
failure_conditions: abandoning the critical core
searching for lost UAVs
no statement within 180 s
